name: Xero

fonts.notes: Headlines: XeroHeadline (Inter Tight ExtraBold), tight line-height 0.98–1.05, sentence case, navy on light / white on navy. Body & CTA: XeroBody / XeroBodyBold. Never use other font families.

logo.clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to the height of the 'x' on all sides; nothing overlaps the wordmark.

colourways.on-photo-or-busy: use the pill: white pill with navy logo, or navy pill with light-blue logo

logo.placement: Bottom-left or bottom-right corner, aligned to the content margin. Exactly one logo per design.

card.notes: Most social ads put the headline + CTA inside a white rounded content card that sits on a light-blue or navy background with a bloom shape behind it.

cta.notes: Short imperative copy: 'Try Xero for free', 'Find out more', 'Switch to Xero', 'Get started'.

productStrip.notes: Optional tiny uppercase product list with mint check marks near the logo.

recipes: A) Card on bloom — background #3ECCFE (or #000856). One big bloom (navy on light blue / #1868D8 or #3ECCFE on navy) partially off-canvas (e.g. x=-0.15W, y=-0.1H, width=0.9W). White card x=0.07W y=0.08H width=0.86W with children [headline, (subhead), cta]. Lower half: photo or illustration or product-ui (width 0.6–0.8W) anchored bottom, starting below the card. Logo navy width 0.2W bottom-right (or bottom-left) at margin 0.06S; optional 1 charm (0.09W) overlapping the card corner.

B) Headline on navy — background #000856. stack x=0.06W y=0.08H width=0.88W with children [headline white 0.08S, cta bg #3ECCFE color #000856]. Light-blue bloom bottom-right partially off canvas behind an illustration (width 0.7W) in the lower half. Logo white or light-blue bottom-left width 0.2W.

C) Light blue statement — background #3ECCFE, navy bloom at bottom; white card [headline, subhead, cta]; product-ui device shot overlapping the card bottom edge; logo navy bottom-right; checklist near logo.
D) Stat — background #000856; stack [stat text e.g. "93%" white, headline white 0.06S, legal]; light-blue bloom; logo light-blue.

E) Photo hero — generate a photo (purpose photo, 1024x1536 for portrait) filling the lower 55–60%: photo x=0, width=W, y≈0.42H, height=H-y (photos are cover-cropped, faces kept); card with headline+cta in the top 40%; navy bloom peeking from a corner; logo with pill if it sits over the photo.

F) Split photo — background #FFFFFF. Left column: stack x=0.07W y=0.12H width=0.42W children [label in #1868D8, headline navy 0.07S, subhead, cta navy]. Right half: generated photo x=0.52W y=0 width=0.48W height=H (cover-cropped), with a light-blue bloom peeking behind its bottom-left corner. Logo navy bottom-left under the text column.

G) Testimonial — background #000856. Big quote mark as text role stat in #3ECCFE 0.18S at top-left; stack [headline = the quote in white 0.055S sentence case (max 3 lines), label = name + role in #3ECCFE]; small circular generated photo of the person (shape circle behind an image with cornerRadius) bottom-right; logo white bottom-left.

H) Feature list — background #3ECCFE. White card [headline navy, checklist of 3–4 benefits with mint checks (columns 1, fontSize 0.03S), cta]. Product-ui phone shot overlapping the card’s right edge from the bottom; navy bloom top-right; logo navy bottom-left.

I) Offer badge — background #000856. stack [label in #3ECCFE e.g. LIMITED TIME, headline white 0.08S with the offer e.g. 90% off for 6 months, legal line]. A light-blue circle shape (0.32W) top-right holding stat text e.g. 90% in navy 0.12S; illustration bottom-left; cta light-blue pill; logo white bottom-right.

9:16.note: Meta Stories/Reels: keep text, CTA and logo out of the top 14% and bottom 35%.

voice.tone: Confident, warm, plain-spoken, a little witty. Short punchy sentences. Sentence case. Speaks to small business owners.
headlinePatterns: Two short sentences: 'Data in. Doubt out.'
Benefit + relief: 'Cash flow without the suspense.'
Outcome: 'Up and running in under 4 hours.'
Contrast: 'Run your business, not your books.'
Proof: '93% of customers say Xero is easy to use.*'

imagery.blooms: Fern-inspired organic shapes in light blue, bloom blue or navy. Use one large bloom partially cropped off the canvas edge behind the card or photo. Never recolour outside the palette.
imagery.illustrations: Flat vector, sweeping blue ribbon shapes with small colourful objects (coins, calendar, phone, charts). Use on navy or light-blue backgrounds, never over photos.
imagery.charms: Small 3D-ish icons (sparkle, heart, check, thumbs up, hourglass, %). Use 1–2 as accents near the card edge or photo; keep small (≤12% of canvas width).
imagery.photos: Real small-business owners, warm natural light, candid. Crop inside a bloom shape or place in the lower half under the card.
imagery.productUI: Device shots with Xero dashboard screens — use when the message is about the software itself.

rules: Use only brand palette colours for backgrounds, text, shapes and CTAs.
Headlines in XeroHeadline; body and CTA text in XeroBody/XeroBodyBold.
Exactly one Xero wordmark per design, at least 14% of canvas width, in a corner with clear space.
Navy logo on light backgrounds; light-blue or white logo on navy; use the pill over photos.
Headline ≤ 60 characters, sentence case, no exclamation marks.
Text contrast must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1).
Respect platform safe zones (Meta 9:16: top 14%, bottom 35%).
Keep all text and the logo at least 5% away from canvas edges.
Blooms and photos may bleed off the canvas; text, logo and CTA may not.

imageStyles.illustration: Flat vector illustration in the Xero brand style: bold simple shapes, one sweeping ribbon-like bloom in light blue (#3ECCFE) and blue (#1868D8), small playful objects with accents of mint green, pink, yellow and purple, soft 3D-ish shading, clean edges, optimistic small-business mood. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers or logos. Isolated subject on a fully transparent background.
imageStyles.photo: Editorial photograph of a real small business owner at work, candid, warm natural light, shallow depth of field, authentic and optimistic, modern workspace. No text or logos anywhere. Compose with the subject’s face in the upper-middle of the frame with clear headroom, so the image survives cropping.
imageStyles.background: Abstract minimal background made of smooth organic fern-inspired bloom shapes in Xero blue (#1868D8) on light blue (#3ECCFE), flat vector, no gradients, no text, large soft curves that bleed off the edges.
imageStyles.charm: Small glossy 3D icon in Xero brand style: light blue (#3ECCFE) and blue (#1868D8) with a mint, pink or yellow accent, simple, playful, soft shading. No text. Isolated on a fully transparent background.
